components: Sampling or runtime metrics reveal disproportionate keys.
Large keys are isolated, salted, or replicated separately.
Heavy-key records spread across additional workers.
Non-skewed keys retain the inexpensive default path.
Partial heavy-key results recombine into one logical result.
